items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: the only band I remember was Anthony Holmes band my daddy was playing

ctx.x: do you remember much about the music up there before we get on to your later life when you were a kid what kind of bands or did they have any dance orchestras or anything up in the country there what kind of music did you hear when you were a kid

the only band I remember was Anthony Holmes band my daddy was playing but I never did attend no dancing because I was too small I didn't attend no dances up there but I used to go sometimes go around to rehearsals like that sometimes they had a good band they had a good you know old time band well they had a good band at that time because they used to play all those baton rouge and you know what I mean
oh they did they moved around yeah they used to move around did they play in New Orleans too come down to New Orleans yeah
